title: Server-side form validation
description: Server-side validation for item forms with errors rendered in the htmx fragment
spec:
1. Submit the add form with an empty name; confirm the server rejects it and the returned fragment shows a 'name required' error next to the field (no crash, no 500).
2. Submit with a negative quantity; confirm rejection with a 'quantity must be >= 0' error in the fragment.
3. Submit with a non-numeric quantity; confirm defensive parsing and a validation error, not an unhandled exception.
4. Submit with an invalid/malformed expiry date; confirm a 'valid date required' error and no partial write.
5. Confirm that on any validation failure the previously entered field values are preserved in the re-rendered form.
6. Confirm a valid submission after fixing errors succeeds and creates/updates the item.
7. Confirm validation runs on both add and edit paths.
8. Confirm threshold accepts only a non-negative integer and defaults to 1 when omitted.
9. Confirm no invalid item is ever persisted to the store on a failed validation.
10. Confirm error responses return an appropriate status (e.g. 422/400) with the error fragment, not a generic 500.
